summary:
[  edit  ]
The Arm  SOP  creates all the necessary geometry for an arm, and provides a smooth, untwisted skin that connects the arm to the body. It is controlled through inverse kinematics linked to a handprint.

parameters.label: Capture Type
parameters.name: capttype
parameters.description: ⊞  - You can use either  Ellipses  or  Capture Regions  as deformation geometry. Ellipses are for use with the Skeleton  SOP . Capture Regions are for use with the Capture  SOP .

parameters.label: Arm Axis
parameters.name: axis
parameters.description: ⊞  - Position the model along the +X or -X axis.

parameters.label: Radius
parameters.name: bonerad
parameters.description: Controls the scale of the circle radii.

parameters.label: Rotate Hand
parameters.name: rotatehand
parameters.description: This parameter rotates the hand and the wrist joint to match the orientation of the hand-print object. In order to operate correctly, the end-affector (hand print) scale transformations must remain at 1.

parameters.label: Auto Elbow Twist
parameters.name: autoelbow
parameters.description: This parameter affects the default twist of the elbow joint to a more natural position.

parameters.label: Elbow Twist
parameters.name: elbowtwist
parameters.description: Specifies the rotation angle of the elbow joint.

parameters.label: Flip Elbow
parameters.name: flipelbow
parameters.description: This toggle positions the arm using an alternative elbow position solution.

parameters.label: last_vbo_update_time
parameters.description: Time spent in another thread updating geometry data on the  GPU  from the  SOP 's CPU data. As it is part of another thread, this time is not part of the usual frame time.

parameters.label: last_meta_vbo_update_time
parameters.description: Time spent in another thread updating meta surface geometry data (such as metaballs or nurbs) on the  GPU  from the  SOP 's CPU data. As it is part of another thread, this time is not part of the usual frame time.

parameters.label: total_cooks
parameters.description: Number of times the operator has cooked since the process started.

parameters.label: cook_time
parameters.description: Duration of the last cook in milliseconds.

parameters.label: cook_frame
parameters.description: Frame number when this operator was last cooked relative to the component timeline.

parameters.label: cook_abs_frame
parameters.description: Frame number when this operator was last cooked relative to the absolute time.

parameters.label: cook_start_time
parameters.description: Time in milliseconds at which the operator started cooking in the frame it was cooked.

parameters.label: cook_end_time
parameters.description: Time in milliseconds at which the operator finished cooking in the frame it was cooked.

parameters.label: cooked_this_frame
parameters.description: 1 if operator was cooked this frame.

parameters.label: warnings
parameters.description: Number of warnings in this operator if any.

parameters.label: errors
parameters.description: Number of errors in this operator if any.

parameters.label: The sub
parameters.description: Family  of  Component  types that are used to define and render 3D scenes. A  Geometry Component  is an Object that contains the 3D shapes to render. A  Camera COMP  and  Light COMP  are other Object types. Separately, "Objects" also refers to Python objects.

parameters.label: The Graphics Processing Unit. This is the high
parameters.description: speed, many-core processor of the graphics card/chip that takes geometry, images and data from the CPU and creates images and processed data.

Puede generar copias basándose en parámetros (número de copias, transformaciones acumulativas) o utilizando un POP de plantilla, donde los puntos de una entrada definen la ubicación de la copia. Las transformaciones (traslación, rotación, escala) se pueden aplicar en varios órdenes.2 * Parámetros: Incluye la "Página Copy" (Number of Copies, Transform Order, Translate, Rota

ales o aplicar efectos basados en la proximidad. * **Noise POP (POP de Ruido)** * **Función principal:** Este POP aplica un **campo de ruido** (valores suaves y aleatorios en 3D) a tus puntos, generalmente moviendo su posición (`P`). * **Características clave:** * Ofrece diferentes **tipos de ruido** como Simplex y Perlin, en 2D, 3D o 4D. * Puedes controlar la **"rugosidad" o el detalle** del ruido con parámetros como `Period` (distancia entre picos) y `Harmonics` (capas de detalle adicionales). * Permite ajustar la **magnitud** (`Amplitude`) y el `Offset` de los valores de ruido. * Puede generar y nombrar nuevos atributos para los valores de ruido sin procesar, así como sus derivadas (como `NoiseGradient` y `NoiseCurl`). * Puedes hacer que los **parámetros del ruido cambien por cada punto** individualmente, usando atributos de entrada (`Map` page). * **Uso simple:** Ideal para simular el movimiento de humo,
